Frogeye leaf spot reference shows similar circular spots with gray centers and dark margins. Very consistent with the test image. Let me check other candidates.

Phyllosticta shows much larger, irregular lesions. Not a match. Let me check Soybean rust.
Soybean rust shows many small tan/brown spots densely scattered, but they lack the distinct gray center with dark border seen in the test image. Let me check Bacterial Pustule.
That's a microscopic view, hard to compare. Let me check Cercospora.
Cercospora shows reddish-purple/bronze discoloration with many spots coalescing. Different from the test image's distinct circular gray-centered spots. Let me check Downy mildew.
Downy mildew shows pale yellow/light green spots without dark borders. Very different. Let me check Bacterial Blight for completeness.

Bacterial blight shows angular spots with yellow-green halos. Different from the test image.

After viewing 8 references across 8 different classes, the evidence is clear. The test image shows small, circular spots with gray/tan centers and distinct dark reddish-brown borders on a soybean leaf. This matches Frogeye leaf spot perfectly, both visually (the first reference was nearly identical) and by symptom description ("small, irregular to circular in shape, and gray with reddish-brown borders").
